e.title: High-Cardinality Covariates Regularization (Wüthrich)
e.summary: 高基数类别协变量网络回归论文 R 代码（SSRN 4549049）：正则化处理高基数特征
e.body: High-Cardinality-Covariates-Regularization 是 Wüthrich 论文《High-Cardinality Categorical Covariates in Network Regressions》（SSRN 4549049）的 R 代码：在神经网络回归中正则化处理高基数类别协变量（邮编、车型、职业等）——防止过拟合同时保持因子可解释性。与 [[glmmnet]]（高基数特征 ML）、[[machine-learning-pricing]] 同主题互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[aitools4actuaries]]、[[insurancerating]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：SSRN 4549049《High-Cardinality Categorical Covariates in Network Regressions》R 代码
e.summary_en: R code of Wüthrich's paper on high-cardinality categorical covariates in network regressions (SSRN 4549049): regularization for high-cardinality features
e.summary_hk: 高基數類別協變量網絡回歸論文 R 代碼（SSRN 4549049）：正則化處理高基數特徵
e.body_en: High-Cardinality-Covariates-Regularization is the R code of Wüthrich's paper 'High-Cardinality Categorical Covariates in Network Regressions' (SSRN 4549049): regularized treatment of high-cardinality categorical covariates (postcode, vehicle type, occupation) in neural-network regressions — preventing overfitting while keeping factor interpretability. Same theme as [[glmmnet]] (ML with high-cardinality features) — complementary. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[aitools4actuaries]], [[insurancerating]].
e.body_hk: High-Cardinality-Covariates-Regularization 是 Wüthrich 論文《High-Cardinality Categorical Covariates in Network Regressions》（SSRN 4549049）的 R 代碼：在神經網絡回歸中正則化處理高基數類別協變量（郵編、車型、職業等）——防止過擬合同時保持因子可解釋性。與 [[glmmnet]]（高基數特徵 ML）、[[machine-learning-pricing]] 同主題互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[aitools4actuaries]]、[[insurancerating]]。
